verdict.rationale: Pilot's docs claim 'Full accounts payable' as a service offering and mention integration with Bill.com, implying AP handling, but there is no evidence describing an accountant-facing workflow for capturing bills, routing approvals, or scheduling payments — Pilot's model is a done-for-you bookkeeping service rather than a self-serve AP tool. Missing for 10: explicit bill capture/OCR feature, approval routing mechanics, payment scheduling details, and any hands-on/community confirmation of this specific workflow.
